personality_one_liner: An uncompromising, tactical study operations center built for high-performance curriculum mastery, deterministic pacing, and zero-distraction focus.

spacing.rule: Generous and rigorous 4pt grid rhythm with compact operational padding for high glanceability.

do's: Use tonal separation, sharp borders, and high-contrast typographic hierarchy.
dont's: Avoid heavy glass blur and soft decorative shadows that reduce operational clarity.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: First-launch welcome, curriculum setup, and capacity configuration with zero friction.
screens.layout: Full-bleed dark tactical backdrop, progressive step wizard, clean numeric inputs for weekly hours.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Today's core sprint tasks, streak status, progress percentage, and deterministic elastic schedule overview.

states.loading: Skeleton card loader with pulsing amber indicators
states.empty: Icon + 'All curriculum sprints caught up!' + 'Study Ahead' CTA

screens.layout: Top sticky operations header, primary task checklist card stack, progress metrics rail, bottom sticky action bar.

screens.name: Curriculum
screens.purpose: Bundled 9-sprint curriculum browser with module details and completion breakdown.

states.empty: Empty curriculum state + reload default modules
states.error: Error state with database recovery option

screens.layout: Vertical collapsible sprint accordion list with progress badges and status indicators.

screens.name: Schedule
screens.purpose: Calendar view displaying planned days, missed-day handling, future freedom/unavailable days, and Study Ahead controls.

states.error: Failed to calculate elastic schedule error view

screens.layout: Matrix grid calendar with color-coded day states (completed, active, missed, freedom day, study ahead).

screens.name: Metrics
screens.purpose: Detailed analytics, completion velocity charts, streaks, and curriculum completion metrics.

states.empty: Complete your first sprint to unlock analytics

screens.layout: Card-based data widgets, progress velocity rings, and summary stat counters.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Weekday/Saturday/Sunday capacity configuration, local notifications toggles, offline persistence backup/restore, and reset progress.
screens.layout: Grouped operational preference rows with switches, steppers, and destructive action controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the complete Curriculum Tracker & Study Planner mobile app using Expo and React Native with 100% offline local persistence, bundled 9-sprint curriculum, deterministic elastic scheduling algorithm, task completion tracking, missed-day handling, study ahead, local notifications, JSON export/import, and settings. Strictly adhere to Dark-First Utility personality (Personality #7) with amber (#F59E0B) warm accents, Obsidian surfaces (#12141C / #1A1D26), Barlow Condensed headings, and Satoshi body text. Ensure all touch targets are >=44x44pt, safe areas are respected, and loading/empty/error states are fully handled.
